title: Reverse-mode autodiff with a Value class
summary: Build a scalar Value class that records operations and computes gradients by reverse-mode automatic differentiation.

mutants.overwrite_grad: Sets the gradient of an operand with = and not +=, so a value that is used twice keeps only the last gradient.
mutants.tanh_wrong_derivative: Uses 1 - tanh(x) and not 1 - tanh(x) squared as the derivative of tanh.
mutants.pow_wrong_exponent: Uses n * x ** n and not n * x ** (n - 1) as the derivative of a power.
mutants.forward_order: Runs the local backward steps in the order of the forward pass and not in reverse order.
mutants.root_grad_missing: Does not set the gradient of the output to 1 before the backward pass, so every gradient is 0.
